title: One Piece Teases Jump Festa 2027 With New Update
content: Shueisha is gearing up for one of the biggest events of the year, Jump Festa, which is always held toward the end of the year. With One Piece being one of the conglomerate’s biggest manga franchises, it has a major lineup planned.
author: ComicBook

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Streams Animated Trailer for Tokyo Revengers DLC Characters Mikey, Draken
content: SNK began streaming on Thursday an animated trailer for its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game featuring the DLC characters Manjiro "Mikey" Sano and Ken "Draken" Ryuguji from the Tokyo Revengers anime.
author: ANN

title: Firefly Wedding TV Anime Casts Kazuyuki Okitsu
content: The official X/ Twitter account for the television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding manga revealed a new cast member on Thursday. Kazuyuki Okitsu voices Eishin Nitobe, the Metropolitan Police Department superintendent general's son: The anime stars Lynn as Satoko Kirigaya and Kōki Uchiyama as Shinpei Gotō.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover's ONE OR EIGHT to Perform in Manila
content: Rising Japanese boy group ONE OR EIGHT is ready to take off with their bar-setting momentum to Manila with ONE OR EIGHT Special SHOW CASE 2026 in ASIA -V8– at Samsung Hall, SM Aura Premier, on October 23, 2026. ONE OR EIGHT performed the ending theme for the second season of Black Clover .
author: Anime Corner

title: Psyren TV Anime Casts Reiko Suzuki, Ayumu Murase
content: The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga announced on Thursday that it has cast Reiko Suzuki as Elmore Tenjuin (pictured below on right) and Ayumu Murase as Van Tenjuin (left): Global Stage Hollywood screened the world premiere for the second episode of the anime at…
author: ANN

title: Exclusive: Nakama Press Licenses Uoto's 100 Meters, Goku Midnight Eye Manga for Release in 2027
content: Mad Cave Studios' imprint Nakama Press announced on Thursday that it has licensed Uoto 's 100 Meters ( Hyakuemu ) manga, and will release the first two volumes in 2027. Nakama Press will release the manga's first volume on February 17 and the second volume on April 27.
author: ANN

title: Spy x Family Teases Jump Festa Update as Fans Wait for Season 4
content: It’s been a while since Spy x Family Season 3 reached its conclusion, but fans still haven’t received any updates on the anime’s future. The anime premiered its latest season in October last year as part of the Fall 2025 lineup, where it featured some of the fan-favorite arcs.
author: ComicBook

title: Yūichirō Momose, Hina Hinata's Bagudan Manga Ends on November 24
content: The December issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Dessert magazine announced on Friday that Hypnosis Mic writer Yūichirō Momose and artist Hina Hinata's Bagudan: Sono Otoko-tachi Toriatsukai Chūi ni Tsuki (Bagudan: Handle These Men with Care) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on November 24.
author: ANN

title: Takopi's Original Sin Compilation Film's Trailer Reveals Theme Song
content: The official X/Twitter account for the anime of Taizan 5 's Takopi's Original Sin ( Takopii no Genzai ) manga unveiled on Friday a new trailer and visual for the Takopii no Genzai -Arigatō, Mata Ashita- ( Takopi's Original Sin : Thank You, See You Tomorrow) compilation film .
